scenes.title_en: Basics Plus a Pop of Bright
scenes.context: 穿搭启发：身上大色块都是基础色时，可以在配饰上加小面积亮色，拍照背景选择跟配饰颜色撞色的背景，容易出片。比如紫色木门框配薄荷绿手表和包。语域：审美分享，穿搭思路。
sentences: 大色块用基础色，配饰加小面积亮色。
Keep big blocks basic, add a pop of bright on accessories.
a pop of bright（小面积亮色）
选撞色的背景，容易出片。
Pick a clashing background for easy standout shots.
standout shots（出片）
紫门框配薄荷绿，一刷就注意到。
A purple frame with mint green catches the eye instantly.
catches the eye（抓眼）
paraphrase: 小面积亮色 → a pop of bright / small bright accent
撞色背景 → clashing background / complementary backdrop
scenes.speak: Keep big blocks basic, add a pop of bright on accessories. Pick a clashing background for easy standout shots. A purple frame with mint green catches the eye instantly.

scenes.context: 发型启发：眼位比较高的女生想遮额头，可以试试复古大框墨镜，这种款式能模糊原生的高眼位，让比例更和谐。语域：审美分享，配饰选择。
sentences: 眼位高，用复古大框墨镜。
High-set eyes? Try retro, oversized frames.
oversized frames（大框墨镜）
它能模糊原生的高眼位。
They soften a naturally high eye line.
high eye line（高眼位）
面部比例更和谐。
The face reads more balanced.
reads more balanced（比例更和谐）
scenes.speak: High-set eyes? Try retro, oversized frames. They soften a naturally high eye line. The face reads more balanced.

scenes.context: 软装启发：买不到契合审美的花瓶，可以在花瓶外层包上喜欢的布，就像给花盆换皮肤一样。家里绿色大片+木色床板+浅蓝床品很搭。语域：审美分享，软装技巧。
sentences: 买不到合适的花瓶，就给它穿衣服。
Can't find the right vase? Dress it up with fabric.
dress it up（穿衣服）
包上喜欢的布，等于换皮肤。
Wrap it in fabric — like giving it new skin.
new skin（换皮肤）
绿植配木色和浅蓝，很搭。
Greenery with wood tones and pale blue just works.
just works（很搭）
paraphrase: 软装 → home décor / styling the space
换皮肤 → new skin / a makeover
scenes.speak: Can't find the right vase? Dress it up with fabric. Wrap it in fabric — like giving it new skin. Greenery with wood tones and pale blue just works.

scenes.context: 卧室软装启发：白墙挂一个橘黄色小灯，跟床品大面积颜色结合，很温馨。自拍方式启发：两个手机或跟朋友出门，墨镜+耳机两个配饰让画面更丰富。语域：审美分享，软装与自拍。
sentences: 白墙挂橘黄小灯，很温馨。
A tangerine lamp on a white wall feels cozy.
feels cozy（温馨）
小灯和床品颜色结合，好看。
The lamp and bedding colors blend beautifully.
blend beautifully（结合好看）
自拍加墨镜和耳机，画面更丰富。
Add sunglasses and earphones to enrich the frame.
enrich the frame（画面更丰富）
paraphrase: 温馨 → cozy / warm and inviting
scenes.speak: A tangerine lamp on a white wall feels cozy. The lamp and bedding colors blend beautifully. Add sunglasses and earphones to enrich the frame.

practice: Keep big blocks basic, add a pop of bright on accessories.
Wrap it in fabric — like giving it new skin.
Add sunglasses and earphones to enrich the frame.
pitfalls: Keep big blocks basic, add a pop of bright on accessories.
「小面积亮色」用 a pop of bright。
「给花瓶穿衣服」用 dress it up。
Add sunglasses and earphones to enrich the frame.
shifts: 用 a pop of bright（小面积亮色）、clashing background（撞色背景）、tone（色调）
用 oversized frames（大框）、retro（复古）、high eye line（高眼位）
用 home décor（软装）、new skin（换皮肤）、cozy（温馨）
footer_notes: 转录基于图文实录完整口播。已校正：大色块基础色+配饰小面积亮色、撞色背景、紫门框配薄荷绿、高眼位用复古大框墨镜、模糊高眼位、给花瓶穿衣服换皮肤、绿植配木色浅蓝、白墙挂橘黄小灯、墨镜+耳机丰富画面等。
